name: Coca
summary: Coca is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: The leaves contain cocaine, which acts as a mild stimulant when chewed or consumed as tea; this traditional use involves slower absorption than purified cocaine, and there is no evidence of addiction or withdrawal symptoms from such natural consumption.

uses.text: The leaves contain cocaine, which acts as a mild stimulant when chewed or consumed as tea; this traditional use involves slower absorption than purified cocaine, and there is no evidence of addiction or withdrawal symptoms from such natural consumption. Coca leaves are used commercially and industrially in teas, foods, cosmetics, and beverages.

summaryZh: 古柯鹼（英語：cocaine，C₆H₅COOC₇H₁₀N，其中-COOCH₃位於莨菪烷官能基C₇H₁₀N的2位），又譯為可卡因，學名苯甲醯芽子鹼甲酯，是古柯含有的多種芽子鹼衍生生物鹼之一。芽子鹼衍生物屬於莨菪烷類生物鹼與興奮劑，在世界各地均屬管制藥（毒品）。
summaryZhHans: 可卡因（英语：cocaine，C₆H₅COOC₇H₁₀N，其中-COOCH₃位于莨菪烷官能团C₇H₁₀N的2位），又译为古柯碱，学名苯甲酰芽子碱甲酯，是古柯含有的多种芽子碱衍生生物碱之一。芽子碱衍生物属于莨菪烷类生物碱与兴奋剂，在世界各地均属管制药（毒品）。
